component.name: VKLOD Sample
component.summary: Streaming and Ray Tracing Continuous Level of Detail

description.p: VKLOD Sample is a Vulkan application that renders large scenes with real-time ray tracing using NVIDIA RTX Mega Geometry. It streams continuous level of detail from disk, similar to Nanite's virtual geometry but designed for ray tracing.
Requires an NVIDIA RTX GPU with support for the VK_NV_cluster_acceleration_structure Vulkan extension.

ul.li: Real-time ray tracing with NVIDIA RTX Mega Geometry
Continuous level of detail (LOD) streaming from disk
Cluster acceleration structures for dynamic ray tracing
Per-mesh cluster selection for to reduce BLAS usage
Batched streaming system for smoother framerate

screenshot.caption: VKLOD Sample ray tracing continuous level of detail

description.p: Initial independent and first binary release forked from NVIDIA-RTX/VKLOD-Sample
